{{Top|leg}}
A '''dermal autostripper''' was a luxury device used by certain [[Species/Legends|species]] such as [[Pui-ui]] and [[Lisst'n]] to strip off a layer of skin cells. The [[University of Rudrig/Legends|University of Rudrig]] had dermal autostripper facilities.<ref name="Han Solo and the Lost Legacy">''[[Han Solo and the Lost Legacy]]''</ref>
